contracts_revalidated: Host full positions length uses checked host strand*points before any device fitting. It rejects malformed full source rather than slicing a valid prefix out of a malformed suffix; strands vector itself defines info population.

For host nonempty sources, canonical fitting uses both position stride and info record limits, permits resident0, and native admission checks u32 points/count/sample/draw ranges only for the chosen resident population. Full host collection need not fit native sample addresses. count-as-usize is bounded by original host strand count.

Logical data bytes remain0 for empty population. CPU allocates one16-byte position/info record; GPU path separately checks logical0 prefix, actual positive physical dummy, storage usage and both storage/max-buffer limits. Explicit NonZero binding sizes never expose the entire oversized allocation.

GPU source physical/device guarantee requires the agreed sealed producer implementation. Current missing layout/positions/infos/device APIs make this checkpoint intentionally incomplete; no synthetic brand or compatibility API was introduced.

Nonempty canonical points>=2, samples<=u32MAX and points*2 checked; native_draw_vertices returns0 before multiplication for empty population, including admitted huge-point declarations. Main/shadow/opacity native vertex ranges use this owner; instance ranges and reported primitive counts clamp to each resident canonical strand count.

RenderLevelError retains real StrandLayoutError/BufferPrefixError in derived sources and then HairGpuError::Backend anyhow. New host admission errors hold role and typed logical/physical/limit fields. SDK native creation errors retain the existing explicitly agreed device-handled policy, not a returned validation verdict.

set_groom/set_gpu_groom collect all fallible level candidates before logical scene replacement. Native uploads may occur earlier, but failed admission preserves prior scene; native queue error-policy limits remain explicit.
fc23 guarded-scan doc correction matches independently read canonical95 uniform block guard before lane products/barriers. No renewed requirement for unused public group-input extension.
